description: What Ridge and Rhett have been building lately. Newest first.

entries.note: New gaming props — a TV, VR headset, two controllers, and a Room tab to build the scene around them.
entries.title: Photo Studio v5 — New gaming props

entries.note: Double-tapping a button no longer zooms the game in.
entries.title: Dad's Pool Game v5 — Double-tap zoom fix

entries.note: Correction to an Easter egg.
entries.title: Dad's Pool Game v4 — Correction to an Easter egg

entries.note: New Easter egg added.
entries.title: Dad's Pool Game v3 — New Easter egg

entries.note: Photo Edit Game is now Photo Studio — same tools, new name and a Build Studio badge.
entries.title: Photo Studio v4 — New name

entries.note: Scores now send the game name with them, and a name with a bad word or a link is turned away with a message to pick another name.
entries.title: Ridge World v15 — Wall of Fame game name

entries.note: New Easter egg added.
entries.title: Ridge World v14 — Update 4

entries.note: Pinch-to-zoom turned off so tapping the throw and dash controls no longer zooms the page on iPhone and iPad, and the player picks no longer show the boys' ages — just Ridge, Rhett, or both.
entries.title: Dad's Pool Game v2 — Pinch-to-zoom fix

entries.note: Pinch-to-zoom turned off so holding the joystick with one hand and tapping the FIRE and tool buttons with the other no longer zooms the page on iPhone and iPad.
entries.title: Ridge World v13 — Pinch-to-zoom fix

entries.note: Pinch-to-zoom turned off so tapping the editing tools, stickers, and buttons no longer zooms the page on iPhone and iPad — dragging, resizing, and drawing work the same.
entries.title: Photo Edit Game v3 — Pinch-to-zoom fix

entries.note: Pinch-to-zoom turned off so holding the joystick with one hand and tapping the game pads and buttons with the other no longer zooms the page on iPhone and iPad.
entries.title: TwoRLabs Interactive World v2 — Pinch-to-zoom fix

entries.note: Pinch-to-zoom turned off so tapping the joystick, jump button, and game pads no longer zooms the page on iPhone and iPad.
entries.title: Lobby Game v2 — Pinch-to-zoom fix

entries.note: Play all 22 scenes from the birth of Moses to the crossing of the Red Sea — each scene opens with the story and its Exodus verses, then a mission to play, from the basket in the reeds to holding the staff up to part the sea.
entries.title: Moses — Escape from Egypt v1 — New game

entries.note: Your scores now post to the shared Wall of Fame for everyone to see — submit your name and score at the end of a game and find it on the board at tworlabs.com/wall-of-fame/.
entries.title: Ridge World v12 — Wall of Fame

entries.note: You can now post your edited photo to the Wall of Fame from the top bar — Dad checks each photo first, and approved ones show on the photo wall.
entries.title: Photo Edit Game v2 — Post your edit

entries.note: Jump in the pool with Dad and the boys in a green backyard with an 18-foot round above-ground pool — throw mode with five throws (Normal, Spin, Flip, Body slam, and Double throw) and a dash, or tag mode where red is it.
entries.title: Dad's Pool Game v1 — New game

entries.note: Walk around the TwoRLabs world in the logo's colors — pick Ridge or Rhett, collect sparkles, and play all four game pads (Paint Battle, Block Breaker, Race Rush, and Park Explorer), with a Loading Room mini-game before each one.
entries.title: TwoRLabs Interactive World v1 — New game

entries.note: Upload a photo and edit it — add outfits to people, or put holes in objects and set them on fire, with stickers, drawing, filters, and caption bubbles. Save your edit as a picture.
entries.title: Photo Edit Game v1 — New game

entries.note: Walk around the lobby and explore the park, pond, and workshop, collecting treasures into an inventory bag — then step on a game pad to play Paint Battle, Block Breaker, Race Rush, or Park Explorer.
entries.title: Lobby Game v1 — Explore and collect

entries.note: The move controller (joystick) is now up and to the right by about one button height, so it is easier to reach with your thumb while you play on phones and iPads.
